en.t: Minamoto and Taira forces confront each other at Fujigawa
en.s: On November 9, 1180 in the Western calendar, forces aligned with Minamoto no Yoritomo and the Taira clan faced each other near the Fuji River in what is now Shizuoka, Japan. The Taira force withdrew without a major pitched battle, an early setback for the clan in the Genpei War. Later accounts tell a story about waterbirds startling the Taira camp, but the detail is a tradition rather than a firmly established cause of the retreat.
en.n: Japanese sources give Jishō 4, tenth month, twentieth day; the Western calendar date used here is November 9, 1180.

zh.t: 源氏与平氏军队在富士川对峙
zh.s: 1180年11月9日，源赖朝一方与平氏军队在今日本静冈县富士川附近对峙。平氏军队随后撤退，双方没有展开大规模正面交战。这成为源平战争初期平氏的一次挫折。后世故事称平氏军营受到水鸟惊扰，但这属于传说，不能当作已经证实的撤退原因。
zh.n: 日本史料记为治承四年十月二十日，这里按换算后的西历日期列为1180年11月9日。

en.s: The Treaty of Aberconwy was signed on the 10th of November 1277, and was made between King Edward I of England and Llywelyn ap Gruffudd, Prince of Wales. It followed Edward's invasion of Llywelyn's territories earlier that year. The treaty re-established peace between the two but also essentially guaranteed that Welsh self-rule would end upon Llywelyn's death and represented the completion of the first stage of the Conquest of Wales by Edward I.
en.n: The Treaty of Aberconwy, a humiliating settlement forced on Llywelyn ap Gruffudd by King Edward I of England, brings a temporary end to the Welsh Wars.

zh.s: 阿伯康威条约于1277年11月10日签署，由英格兰国王爱德华一世与威尔士亲王卢埃林·阿普·格鲁菲兹缔结。此前一年，爱德华入侵了卢埃林的领地。条约恢复了双方和平，但也基本确定卢埃林去世后威尔士自治将告终，并标志着爱德华一世征服威尔士的第一阶段完成。
zh.n: 英格兰国王爱德华一世迫使卢埃林·阿普·格鲁菲兹接受屈辱的《阿伯康威条约》，暂时结束了威尔士战争。

en.s: The Battle of Gammelsdorf (German: Schlacht von Gammelsdorf) circled around the question of who would execute tutelage over the minor children of the late Lower Bavarian Dukes, thus also commanding the tremendous economic power of that region. Their Upper Bavarian cousin, Duke Louis, the later Emperor Louis IV, the Bavarian, as agreements within the several branches of the Bavarian line of the House of Wittelsbach determined and as the burghers of the Lower Bavarian cities wanted to see it done, or Duke Frederick I of Austria, the Fair, also Louis' cousin, both having been raised and educated together in Vienna, as the widows and local aristocracy wished?

zh.s: 1313年11月9日，德意志地区爆发加默尔斯多夫战役，争端围绕下巴伐利亚已故公爵的未成年子女由谁监护，以及谁掌控当地财富展开。上巴伐利亚公爵路易和奥地利公爵腓特烈一世都希望取得监护权；下巴伐利亚城镇居民倾向路易，公爵遗孀和当地贵族则支持腓特烈。

en.t: Siege of Warangal: Prataparudra surrenders to Muhammad bin Tughlaq, officially marking the end of the Kakatiya dynasty
en.s: Fakhr-ud-Din Muhammad Shah (Persian: فخر الدین محمد شاہ), better known as Muhammad bin Tughluq (Persian: محمد بن تغلق; Persian pronunciation: [mu.ham.ˈmad bin tuɣ.ˈlaq]; 1290 – 20 March 1351), or Muhammad III, also known by his epithets, The Eccentric Prince, and The Mad Sultan, was the eighteenth Sultan of Delhi. He reigned from February 1325 until his death in March 1351.

zh.t: 瓦朗加尔围城战：普拉塔帕鲁德拉向穆罕默德·宾·图格鲁克投降，卡卡提亚王朝正式终结
zh.s: 法赫尔丁·穆罕默德·沙（波斯语：فخر الدین محمد شاہ），更广为人知的名字是穆罕默德·宾·图格鲁克（波斯语：محمد بن تغلق；1290年—1351年3月20日），又称穆罕默德三世，也有“古怪王子”和“疯苏丹”等称号，是德里苏丹国第18任苏丹。他从1325年2月在位至1351年3月去世。

en.s: The Battle of Posada (November 9, 1330 – November 12, 1330) was fought between Basarab I of Wallachia and Charles I Robert of Hungary. The small Wallachian army led by Basarab, formed of cavalry and foot archers, as well as local peasants, managed to ambush and defeat the 30,000-strong Hungarian army, in a mountainous region near the border between Oltenia and Severin. The battle resulted in a major Wallachian victory and disaster for Charles Robert, becoming a turning point in the politics of Hungary, which had to abandon its hopes of extending the kingdom to the Black Sea.

zh.s: 波萨达战役发生于1330年11月9日至12日，交战双方是瓦拉几亚的巴萨拉布一世和匈牙利的查理一世·罗贝尔。巴萨拉布率领的瓦拉几亚小军由骑兵、步弓手和当地农民组成，在奥尔特尼亚和塞维林交界处的山区伏击了人数达3万的匈牙利军队并将其击败。这场胜利对瓦拉几亚意义重大，也给查理·罗贝尔造成沉重打击，成为匈牙利政治的转折点；此后匈牙利放弃了向黑海扩张的企图。

en.s: The Battle of Ilava (called also Battle of Rudé Pole, Slovak: Bitka na Rudom poli) took place during the Hussite Wars between the Hussites and the Hungarian-Royalists army near Ilava in Upper Hungary (Slovakia) on November 9, 1431 (sometimes date of November 10th or 11th is given).

zh.s: 伊拉瓦战役又称鲁德波尔战役（斯洛伐克语：Bitka na Rudom poli），于1431年11月9日在胡斯战争期间爆发，交战双方是胡斯派和匈牙利王室军队，地点在上匈牙利的伊拉瓦（今斯洛伐克）。资料有时将战役日期记为11月10日或11日。

en.t: Ulrich II, Count of Celje, last ruler of the County of Cilli, is assassinated in Belgrade
en.s: Ulrich II, or Ulrich of Celje (Slovene: Ulrik Celjski / Urh Celjski; Hungarian: Cillei Ulrik; German: Ulrich II von Cilli; 16 February 1406 – 9 November 1456), was the last Princely Count of Celje. At the time of his death, he was captain general and de facto regent of Hungary, ban (governor) of Slavonia, Croatia and Dalmatia and feudal lord of vast areas in present-day Slovenia, Croatia, Bosnia, Austria, and Slovakia.

zh.t: 采列伯爵乌尔里希二世、采列伯国最后一位统治者在贝尔格莱德遇刺
zh.s: 乌尔里希二世，又称采列的乌尔里希（斯洛文尼亚语：Ulrik Celjski／Urh Celjski；匈牙利语：Cillei Ulrik；德语：Ulrich II von Cilli；1406年2月16日—1456年11月9日），是采列最后一位亲王伯爵。他去世时担任匈牙利总司令并实际执掌摄政权，同时是斯拉沃尼亚、克罗地亚和达尔马提亚的总督，并在今斯洛文尼亚、克罗地亚、波黑、奥地利和斯洛伐克拥有大片封地。

en.t: More than 50 people are sentenced and executed in the Stockholm Bloodbath
en.s: The Stockholm Bloodbath (Swedish: Stockholms blodbad) was a trial that led to a series of executions in Stockholm between 7 and 9 November 1520. The event is also known as the Stockholm massacre. The events occurred after the coronation of Christian II as the new king of Sweden, when guests in the crowning party were invited to a meeting at Tre Kronor castle.

zh.t: 斯德哥尔摩惨案中逾50人被判刑并处决
zh.s: 斯德哥尔摩惨案（瑞典语：Stockholms blodbad）是一场审判，随后于1520年11月7日至9日在斯德哥尔摩发生一系列处决，也称斯德哥尔摩大屠杀。事件发生在克里斯蒂安二世加冕为瑞典国王后，受邀参加加冕庆典的宾客被召集到三王冠城堡开会。

en.s: Battle of Mared was a battle in the Nordic Seven Years' War between the Swedish and Danish forces on 9 November 1563. The battle was held on the site of present-day locality Oskarström in Sweden. After the outbreak of the war, a Swedish army under the command of Eric XIV marched into Halland. The goal was to besiege Halmstad, but it failed because of the lack of artillery. Since the Danish king Frederick II was on his way with reinforcements, the Swedes pulled back. But they were caught up in Mared, where they were defeated.

zh.s: 马雷德战役是北方七年战争期间瑞典和丹麦军队于1563年11月9日进行的一场战斗，地点在今天瑞典奥斯卡斯特伦附近。战争爆发后，埃里克十四世率瑞典军队进入哈兰，计划围攻哈尔姆斯塔德，但因缺少火炮而未能成功。丹麦国王腓特烈二世率援军赶来，瑞典军队撤退途中在马雷德被追上并击败。

en.s: The Rising of the North of 1569, also called the Revolt of the Northern Earls, Northern Rebellion or the Rebellion of the Earls, was an unsuccessful attempt by Catholic nobles from Northern England to depose Queen Elizabeth I of England and replace her with Mary, Queen of Scots.

en.s: The Battle of Lomnice or Lomnice nad Lužnicí occurred on 9 November 1618, during the Bohemian period of the Thirty Years' War. It was fought between the Roman Catholic army of Charles Bonaventure de Longueval, Count of Bucquoy, and the Protestant army of Heinrich Matthias von Thurn. On 23 May 1618, the Bohemian Protestant nobles defeated King Matthias and threw the Roman Catholic governors of Bohemia from a window of their office at Prague Castle in an act which came to be known as the Defenestration of Prague. The new government, formed of Protestant nobility and Heinrich Matthias von Thurn, assumed command over the Bohemian Protestant forces.

zh.s: 洛姆尼采战役又称卢日尼采河畔洛姆尼采战役，于1618年11月9日在三十年战争的波希米亚阶段爆发。交战双方是布奎伯爵夏尔·博纳旺蒂尔·德·隆格瓦尔率领的天主教军队，以及海因里希·马蒂亚斯·冯·图恩率领的新教军队。1618年5月23日，波希米亚新教贵族击败马蒂亚斯国王，并把波希米亚的天主教总督从布拉格城堡的办公室窗户扔了出去，这一事件后来被称为布拉格掷出窗外事件。由新教贵族组成的新政府随后把指挥权交给冯·图恩。

en.s: In the Great Northern War (1700–1721) a coalition led by Russia successfully contested the supremacy of Sweden in Northern, Central and Eastern Europe. The initial leaders of the anti-Swedish alliance were Peter I of Russia, Frederick IV of Denmark–Norway and Augustus II the Strong of Saxony-Poland-Lithuania.

zh.t: 大北方战争结束之际，瑞典与汉诺威签订条约，将不来梅和费尔登公国（今德国北部）割让给汉诺威
zh.s: 大北方战争（1700—1721）中，由俄罗斯领导的联盟成功挑战了瑞典在北欧、中欧和东欧的霸权。反瑞典联盟最初的领导人包括俄国彼得一世、丹麦—挪威的腓特烈四世，以及萨克森—波兰—立陶宛的奥古斯特二世。

en.s: The Treaty of Seville was signed on 9 November 1729 between Britain, France, and Spain, formally ending the 1727–1729 Anglo-Spanish War; the Dutch Republic joined the Treaty on 29 November. However, the Treaty failed to resolve underlying tensions that led first to the War of Jenkins' Ear in 1739, then the wider War of the Austrian Succession in 1740.

zh.s: 英国、法国和西班牙于1729年11月9日签署《塞维利亚条约》，正式结束1727年至1729年的英西战争。荷兰共和国于11月29日加入条约。不过，该条约未能解决深层矛盾，这些矛盾后来先后引发1739年的詹金斯耳之战和1740年更大范围的奥地利王位继承战争。

en.s: The Battle of Penfui took place on 9 November 1749 in the hillside of Penfui, near modern Kupang. A large Topass army was defeated by a numerically inferior Dutch East India Company force following the withdrawal of the former's Timorese allies from the battlefield, resulting in the death of the Topass leader Gaspar da Costa.

zh.s: 彭富战役于1749年11月9日在今天古邦附近的彭富山坡上爆发。托帕斯军队人数较多，但在其帝汶盟友撤出战场后，被人数较少的荷兰东印度公司军队击败。托帕斯领袖加斯帕·达科斯塔也在战斗中丧生。

en.s: The Battle of Fishdam Ford was an attempted surprise attack by British forces under the command of Major James Wemyss against an encampment of Patriot militia under the command of local Brigadier General Thomas Sumter around 1 am on the morning of November 9, 1780, late in the American Revolutionary War. Wemyss was wounded and captured in the attack, which failed because of heightened security in Sumter's camp and because Wemyss did not wait until dawn to begin the attack.

zh.s: 菲什丹浅滩之战发生于美国独立战争后期。1780年11月9日凌晨1点左右，詹姆斯·韦姆斯少校率领英军，试图突袭托马斯·萨姆特准将指挥的爱国者民兵营地。韦姆斯在袭击中受伤并被俘。由于萨姆特营地戒备加强，加上韦姆斯没有等到天亮就发动进攻，这次突袭失败。

en.s: The Battle of Limburg, also called the Battle of Friedberg, was a battle of the War of the First Coalition, itself part of the French Revolutionary Wars. It took place on 9 November 1792 at Limburg an der Lahn between French Revolutionary forces and Prussian troops, ending in a French victory.

zh.s: 林堡战役又称弗里德贝格战役，是第一次反法同盟战争中的一场战斗，也是法国大革命战争的一部分。战斗于1792年11月9日在兰河畔林堡爆发，交战双方是法国革命军和普鲁士军队，最终法军获胜。

en.s: The Coup of 18 Brumaire (French: Coup d'État du 18 Brumaire) brought Napoleon Bonaparte to power as First Consul of the French First Republic. In the view of most historians, it ended the French Revolution and would soon lead to the coronation of Napoleon as Emperor of the French. This bloodless coup d'état overthrew the Directory, replacing it with the French Consulate. This occurred on 9 November 1799, which was 18 Brumaire, Year VIII, under the short-lived French Republican calendar system.

zh.s: 雾月十八日政变（法语：Coup d'État du 18 Brumaire）使拿破仑·波拿巴掌握权力，成为法兰西第一共和国的第一执政。许多历史学家认为，这场政变结束了法国大革命，并很快导致拿破仑加冕称帝。政变没有流血，推翻督政府并以执政府取而代之。事件发生于1799年11月9日，即法国共和历八年雾月十八日。

zh.s: 利亚斯科瓦战役又称利亚霍沃战役，于1812年11月9日在利亚斯科瓦村附近爆发。瓦西里·瓦西里耶维奇·奥尔洛夫-杰尼索夫率领3,500名哥萨克，在杰尼斯·瓦西里耶维奇·达维多夫、亚历山大·萨莫伊洛维奇·菲格纳和亚历山大·尼基季奇·谢斯拉温的协助下，包围了让-皮埃尔·奥热罗率领的2,000名大军团士兵。

en.s: The Battle of Pensacola (7–9 November 1814) took place, following the Creek War, as part of the Gulf Coast operations during the War of 1812. General Andrew Jackson led his infantry against British and Spanish forces controlling the city of Pensacola in Spanish Florida. en.s: The Action of 9 November 1822 was a naval battle fought between the United States Navy schooner USS Alligator and a squadron of three piratical schooners off the coast of Cuba during the US Navy's West Indies Anti-Piracy Operation. Fifteen leagues from Matanzas, Cuba, a large band of pirates captured several vessels and held them for ransom. Upon hearing of the pirate attacks, the Alligator under Lieutenant William Howard Allen rushed to the scene to rescue the vessels and seize the pirates. Upon arriving at the bay where the pirates were said to be, USS Alligator dispatched boats to engage the enemy vessels, as the water was too shallow for the US warship to engage them herself.

zh.s: 1822年11月9日，美国海军纵帆船“短吻鳄”号在西印度群岛反海盗行动中，于古巴海岸与三艘海盗纵帆船交战。马坦萨斯外海约15里格处，一伙海盗劫持了数艘船并索要赎金。得知袭击后，威廉·霍华德·艾伦中尉率“短吻鳄”号赶往现场营救船只、抓捕海盗。抵达海盗出没的海湾后，由于水太浅，军舰无法直接攻击，于是派出小艇迎战。

Armstrong ran for re-election to a full term in office, but was defeated for the Whig nomination by Edward Everett. In the general election, Armstrong ran without party support but finished a distant third behind Everett and Democrat Marcus Morton.

zh.s: 马萨诸塞州于1835年11月9日举行州长选举。临时州长、辉格党人塞缪尔·T·阿姆斯特朗竞选正式任期，但在党内提名中败给爱德华·埃弗里特。大选中，阿姆斯特朗虽以无党派身份参选，最终仍远远落后于埃弗里特和民主党人马库斯·莫顿，位列第三。

The rebels were defeated in this battle, one of the last of the Lower Canada Rebellion of 1838.

zh.s: 奥德尔敦战役于1838年11月9日爆发，交战双方是刘易斯·奥德尔和查尔斯·麦卡利斯特率领的保皇志愿军，以及罗伯特·纳尔逊、梅达尔·埃贝尔和查尔斯·欣德朗率领的爱国者叛军。叛军战败。这是1838年下加拿大叛乱期间最后几场战役之一。

en.t: 1840 United States presidential election in Massachusetts
en.s: A presidential election was held in Massachusetts on November 9, 1840 as part of the 1840 United States presidential election. Voters chose 14 representatives, or electors to the Electoral College, who voted for president and vice president. Massachusetts voted for the Whig candidate, William Henry Harrison, over Democratic candidate Martin Van Buren. Harrison won Massachusetts by a margin of 16.16%.

en.s: The 1865 North Carolina gubernatorial election was held on November 9, 1865, in order to elect the Governor of North Carolina. This was the first election held in North Carolina following the end of the American Civil War. The former North Carolina State Treasurer Jonathan Worth defeated the incumbent provisional governor William Woods Holden. Both candidates ran as Unionists.

en.s: The Battle of Havana on 9 November 1870 was a single ship action between the German gunboat Meteor and the French aviso Bouvet off the coast of Havana, Cuba during the Franco-Prussian War. At 8 a.m. on November 7 the Meteor arrived in Havana harbour after leaving Nassau some days before. An hour later the French aviso Bouvet arrived from Martinique, steaming in from the opposite direction. The next day the French mail steamer SS Nouveau Monde left the harbour for Veracruz but was forced to return a few hours later due to fears that she would be captured by the Prussian gunboat.

zh.s: 1870年11月9日，普法战争期间，德国炮艇“流星”号与法国通报舰“布韦”号在古巴哈瓦那近海交战，双方各有一艘舰船参战。两舰此前相继抵达哈瓦那港；法国邮船担心遭德舰截获，一度从港口驶出后又折返。

en.s: The 1880 earthquake which struck Zagreb, and is also known as The Great Zagreb earthquake, occurred with a moment magnitude of 6.3 on 9 November 1880. Its epicenter was in the Medvednica mountain north of Zagreb. Although only one person was killed in the earthquake, it destroyed or damaged many buildings and spurred a renovation program in the city's historic center.

en.t: Mapuche rebels attack the fortified Chilean settlement of Temuco
en.s: The last major rebellion of the indigenous Mapuches of Araucanía took place in 1881, during the last phase of the Occupation of Araucanía (1861–1883) by the Chilean state. It was planned by Mapuche chiefs in March 1881 to be launched in November the same year. Mapuche support for the uprising was not unanimous: Some Mapuche factions sided with the Chileans and others declared themselves neutral.

zh.s: 阿劳卡尼亚原住民马普切人的最后一次大规模起义发生于1881年，当时智利国家对阿劳卡尼亚的占领（1861—1883）已进入最后阶段。马普切首领于1881年3月策划在当年11月发动起义。马普切人对起义的支持并不一致：一些派别支持智利人，另一些则宣布中立。

en.s: The Russian invasion of Manchuria or Chinese expedition (Russian: Китайская экспедиция) occurred in the aftermath of the First Sino-Japanese War (1894–1895) when concerns regarding Qing China's defeat by the Empire of Japan, and Japan's brief occupation of Liaodong, caused the Russian Empire to speed up their long held designs for imperial expansion across Eurasia. In the five years preceding the invasion, the Russian Empire established a network of leased territories in Manchuria.
en.n: Russian invasion of Manchuria: Russia completes its occupation of Manchuria with 100,000 troops.

zh.s: 甲午战争（1894—1895年）后，清朝败给日本，日本短暂占领辽东半岛，引发俄国对清朝的担忧。俄国随即加快了在欧亚大陆扩张的长期计划，入侵满洲。入侵前五年，俄国已在满洲建立一系列租借地。

en.s: The Alberta general election of 1905 was the first general election held in the Province of Alberta, Canada. It was held on 9 November 1905, to elect members of the Alberta legislature to the 1st Alberta Legislative Assembly, shortly after the province was created out of the Northwest Territories on 1 September 1905. The Alberta Liberal Party of Alexander C. Rutherford won twenty three of the twenty five seats in the new legislature, defeating the Conservative Party, which was led by a young lawyer, Richard Bennett, who later served as Prime Minister of Canada.

zh.s: 1905年艾伯塔省大选是加拿大艾伯塔省成立后的首次大选，于1905年11月9日举行，选出艾伯塔省第一届立法议会议员。该省于同年9月1日从西北地区划出后不久便举行了这次选举。亚历山大·C·卢瑟福领导的艾伯塔自由党赢得25席中的23席，击败由年轻律师理查德·贝内特领导的保守党。贝内特后来成为加拿大总理。

en.s: The 1913 Copa de Honor Municipalidad de Buenos Aires was the final that decided the champion of the 9th. edition of this National cup of Argentina. In the match, held in Ferro C. en.s: The Battle of Cocos was a single-ship action that occurred on 9 November 1914, after the Australian light cruiser HMAS Sydney, under the command of John Glossop, responded to an attack on a communications station at Direction Island by the German light cruiser SMS Emden, commanded by Karl von Müller. en.t: Germany's chancellor announces the Kaiser's abdication and a republic is proclaimed
en.s: On November 9, 1918, amid revolution in Germany, Chancellor Max of Baden announced that Kaiser Wilhelm II had abdicated, although Wilhelm had not authorized the announcement. Max handed the chancellorship to Friedrich Ebert. Later that day Philipp Scheidemann publicly proclaimed a German republic in Berlin. Wilhelm issued his formal statement giving up the German and Prussian crowns on November 28, so the announcement and the signed abdication were separate events.
en.n: November 9 was the chancellor's unauthorized announcement and the republic proclamation; Wilhelm's formal abdication statement followed on November 28.

zh.t: 德国首相宣布德皇退位，谢德曼宣布成立共和国
zh.s: 1918年11月9日，德国革命期间，首相巴登的马克斯未经德皇威廉二世授权，就宣布他已经退位。马克斯随后将首相职务交给弗里德里希·艾伯特。当天下午，菲利普·谢德曼在柏林公开宣布成立德意志共和国。威廉二世直到11月28日才正式声明放弃德意志皇帝和普鲁士国王的王位，因此当天的宣布与他本人正式退位是两件事。
zh.n: 11月9日发生的是首相未经授权宣布退位和共和国宣告；威廉二世本人到11月28日才发表正式退位声明。

en.t: Mediterranean U-boat campaign of World War I
en.s: The Mediterranean U-boat Campaign in the Mediterranean Sea was fought by Austria-Hungary and German Empire (with some support by the Ottoman Empire) against the Allies during World War I. It was characterised by the ability of the Central Powers to raid with near impunity during the first years of the war, causing substantial shipping losses, until the introduction of the convoy system allowed the Allies to drastically cut their losses from 1917 on.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.t: 第一次世界大战地中海潜艇战
zh.s: 第一次世界大战期间，奥匈帝国和德意志帝国在地中海对抗协约国，奥斯曼帝国也提供了一些支援。战争初期，同盟国几乎可以不受阻拦地发动袭击，造成大量船只损失。自1917年起，协约国引入护航制度，大幅减少了损失。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.t: The National Fascist Party (Partito Nazionale Fascista or PNF) is founded in Italy
en.s: The National Fascist Party (Italian: Partito Nazionale Fascista, PNF) was a far-right political party in Italy, created by Benito Mussolini as the political expression of Italian fascism and as a reorganisation of the previous Italian Fasces of Combat. The party ruled the Kingdom of Italy from 1922, when Fascists took power with the March on Rome, until the fall of the Fascist regime in 1943, when Mussolini was deposed by the Grand Council of Fascism.

zh.t: 意大利国家法西斯党成立
zh.s: 国家法西斯党（意大利语：Partito Nazionale Fascista，简称PNF）是意大利的极右翼政党，由贝尼托·墨索里尼创建，作为意大利法西斯主义的政治代表，并重组此前的意大利战斗法西斯组织。法西斯党于1922年通过“向罗马进军”夺取政权后统治意大利王国，直至1943年法西斯政权垮台、墨索里尼被法西斯大委员会罢免。

en.s: The Beer Hall Putsch, also known as the Munich Putsch, was a failed coup d'état led by Nazi Party leader Adolf Hitler, General Erich Ludendorff, and other Kampfbund leaders in Munich, Bavaria, on 8–9 November 1923, during the Weimar Republic. Inspired by Benito Mussolini's March on Rome, Hitler's goal was to use Munich as a base for a march against Germany's national government in Berlin.

zh.s: 啤酒馆政变又称慕尼黑政变，是纳粹党领袖阿道夫·希特勒、埃里希·鲁登道夫将军及其他战斗联盟领导人于1923年11月8日至9日在魏玛共和国巴伐利亚州慕尼黑发动的一场失败政变。受贝尼托·墨索里尼进军罗马的启发，希特勒计划以慕尼黑为基地，向柏林进军，推翻德国中央政府。

en.s: Parliamentary elections were held in Austria on 9 November 1930.The Social Democratic Party emerged as the largest faction in the National Council, with 72 of the 165 seats. Voter turnout was 90.2%.

zh.s: 奥地利于1930年11月9日举行议会选举。社会民主党成为国民议会中最大的党团，获得165个席位中的72席，投票率为90.2%。

en.s: General elections were held in Burma on 9 November 1932, having originally been planned for 29 October. The election was held almost solely on the issue of whether Burma should separate from India, as the British government had indicated that it would take the outcome of the elections as an indication of Burmese opinion. Prior to the elections many of the major parties joined either the Anti-Separation League or the Separation League. Despite expectations that the separationists would win, the Anti-Separation League won a majority of seats. However, the anti-separationists were not in favour of maintaining the union with India, but instead called for a better constitution for a separate Burma.

zh.s: 缅甸大选于1932年11月9日举行，原定日期是10月29日。选举几乎完全围绕缅甸是否脱离印度展开；英国政府曾表示，会把选举结果作为衡量缅甸民意的依据。选前，许多主要政党加入了反分离联盟或分离联盟。尽管当时普遍预计分离派会胜出，反分离联盟最终赢得多数席位。不过，反分离派并不主张继续与印度维持联合，而是要求为独立的缅甸制定更好的宪法。

en.s: The Congress of Industrial Organizations (CIO), was a federation of unions that organized workers in industrial unions in the United States and Canada from 1935 to 1955. Created by John L. Lewis in 1935, it was originally called the Committee for Industrial Organization, but changed its name in 1938 when it broke away from the American Federation of Labor. The CIO supported Franklin D. Roosevelt and the New Deal Coalition, and was open to African Americans. Both the CIO and its rival the AFL grew rapidly during the Great Depression. The rivalry for dominance was bitter and sometimes violent.

zh.t: 美国工业组织委员会成立
zh.s: 1935年11月9日，约翰·L·刘易斯在美国劳工联合会内部发起工业组织委员会，推动按行业组织工人。它后来成为覆盖美国和加拿大的工会联合组织，并于1938年脱离美国劳工联合会，改称工业组织大会。

en.s: The Battle of Shanghai (traditional Chinese: 淞滬會戰; simplified Chinese: 淞沪会战; pinyin: Sōng hù huìzhàn) was a major battle fought between the Empire of Japan and the Republic of China in the Chinese city of Shanghai during the Second Sino-Japanese War. It lasted from August 13 to November 26, 1937, and was arguably the single largest and longest battle of the entire war, with it even regarded by some historians as the first battle of World War II.
en.n: Second Sino-Japanese War: The Chinese Army withdraws from the Battle of Shanghai.

zh.s: 淞沪会战是抗日战争期间日本帝国与中华民国在上海展开的一场重大战役，发生于1937年8月13日至11月26日。这场战役可能是整场战争中规模最大、持续时间最长的一场，也有历史学家将其视为第二次世界大战的第一场战役。
zh.n: 抗日战争：国民革命军撤出淞沪会战。

en.s: The Battle of the Duisburg Convoy, also known in Italy as Battle of the Beta Convoy, was fought on the night of 8/9 November 1941 between an Italian convoy, carrying supplies for the Italian Army and civilian authorities and the Afrika Corps in Libya, and a British Naval squadron, which intercepted the convoy. The convoy was named "Beta" by the Italian naval authorities, but is now often referred to as "Duisburg Convoy" after the German steamer Duisburg, the largest ship in the convoy. The Royal Navy's Force K annihilated the convoy, sinking all the merchant ships and the destroyer Fulmine with no loss and almost no damage.

zh.s: 杜伊斯堡船队之战又称贝塔船队之战，发生于1941年11月8日至9日夜间。意大利船队运送物资，前往利比亚支援意大利军队、民政机构和非洲军团；途中遭英国海军分舰队拦截。意大利海军当局将这支船队称为“贝塔”，如今它通常因船队中最大的德国轮船“杜伊斯堡”号而被称为“杜伊斯堡船队”。英国皇家海军K部队全歼船队，击沉所有商船和“富尔米内”号驱逐舰，自身没有损失，舰船也几乎没有受损。

en.s: The Battle of Stalingrad was a major battle on the Eastern Front of World War II in which Nazi Germany and its Axis allies fought the Soviet Union for control of the city of Stalingrad (now Volgograd) in southern Russia. Marked by intense close-quarters combat and heavy civilian losses during aerial bombardment, the battle is considered the largest and deadliest urban battle in military history and the deadliest battle in World War II.
en.n: Battle of Stalingrad: German forces of the 6th Army under general Friedrich Paulus reach the river bank of the Volga, capturing 90% of the ruined city of Stalingrad and splitting the remaining Soviet forces into two narrow pockets.

zh.s: 斯大林格勒战役是二战东线的一场重大战役，纳粹德国及其轴心国盟友与苏联争夺位于俄罗斯南部的斯大林格勒（今伏尔加格勒）。战斗以激烈的近距离交战和空袭造成的大量平民伤亡为特点，被视为军事史上规模最大、伤亡最惨重的城市战，也是二战中伤亡最惨重的战役。
zh.n: 斯大林格勒战役：弗里德里希·保卢斯将军率领的德国第六集团军抵达伏尔加河岸，占领斯大林格勒废墟的90%，并将剩余苏军分割成两个狭小区域。

en.s: Operation FB (29 October – 9 November 1942) took place as part of the Arctic Convoys of the Second World War. The operation consisted of independent sailings by unescorted merchant ships between Iceland and Murmansk. In late 1942, the Allies had taken the offensive against Germany but the dispatch of supplies to the USSR by convoy via the Arctic route was suspended, due to the demands of the Mediterranean campaign.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: “FB”行动发生于1942年10月29日至11月9日，是二战北极船队行动的一部分。行动期间，没有护航的商船分别从冰岛驶往摩尔曼斯克。1942年末，盟军开始对德军采取攻势，但由于地中海战役的需要，盟军暂停了通过北极航线向苏联运送补给。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: The Battle for Piva Trail was a battle between United States Marine Corps and Imperial Japanese Army forces on Bougainville Island. The battle took place on 8–9 November 1943 during the Bougainville campaign of the Pacific War in the days following the US landings at Cape Torokina earlier in the month. The fighting took place inland from the US beachhead, as the Japanese began moving troops from the 23rd Infantry Regiment north from southern Bougainville.
en.n: This entry records the event's end date, as given in the source infobox.

zh.s: 皮瓦小径战役是太平洋战争布干维尔战役期间，美国海军陆战队和日本帝国陆军在布干维尔岛上的一场战斗。战斗于1943年11月8日至9日进行，发生在美军当月早些时候于托罗基纳角登陆后的几天内。战斗地点位于美军滩头阵地内陆，日本军队开始从布干维尔南部调动第23步兵团向北推进。
zh.n: 此条记录采用原文资料框列明的事件结束日期。

en.s: During the Italian Campaign of World War II, the Barbara Line was a series of German military fortifications in Italy, some 10–20 mi (16–32 km) south of the Gustav Line, from Colli al Volturno to the Adriatic Coast in San Salvo and a similar distance north of the Volturno Line. Near the eastern coast, it ran along the line of the Trigno river.

zh.t: 巴尔巴拉防线战事结束
zh.s: 1943年11月9日，第二次世界大战意大利战役中，巴尔巴拉防线一带的战事结束。这是德军在意大利修筑的一系列防御工事，位于古斯塔夫防线以南约16至32公里，从沃尔图诺河畔科利延伸到亚得里亚海岸附近的圣萨尔沃。

en.t: Hwang Kee founds the Moo Duk Kwan martial arts school in Korea
en.s: On November 9, 1945, martial artist Hwang Kee founded the Moo Duk Kwan school in the Yongsan area of Seoul. It began as a place to teach his martial art soon after Korea's liberation from Japanese rule. The school later became part of the history of Tang Soo Do and Soo Bahk Do. November 9 marks the founding of the school; the name Soo Bahk Do was adopted for its martial art later, in 1960.
en.n: The Moo Duk Kwan school opened November 9, 1945; the name Soo Bahk Do for its martial art came later.

zh.t: 黄琦在首尔创办武德馆
zh.s: 1945年11月9日，武术家黄琦在首尔龙山区创办武德馆，开始传授武术。当时朝鲜刚摆脱日本殖民统治。武德馆后来与唐手道和手搏道的发展密切相关。11月9日是武德馆创办的日期；“手搏道”这个名称直到1960年才被采用。
zh.n: 11月9日创办的是武德馆，手搏道的名称后来才出现。

en.t: Japan's Liberal Party is founded after World War II
en.s: On November 9, 1945, Ichirō Hatoyama, Masazumi Andō, Hitoshi Ashida and other politicians founded the Japan Liberal Party. The party brought together figures linked to the prewar Seiyūkai and to a wartime Diet group that had opposed Hideki Tōjō. It emerged as political parties were reorganizing after Japan's surrender in World War II. This was the 1945 Liberal Party, not the later Liberal Democratic Party formed in 1955.
en.n: The National Diet Library and the retained article both date this party's founding to November 9, 1945.

zh.s: 1945年11月9日，鸠山一郎、安藤正纯、芦田均等人在日本成立自由党。党员包括战前政友会人士，以及战争期间曾反对东条英机的国会议员。日本在二战结束后重新组织政党，这个自由党便是在这一时期出现的。它与1955年成立的自由民主党不是同一个政党。
zh.n: 日本国立国会图书馆和留存条目都将这个自由党的成立日期记为1945年11月9日。

en.s: The 1946 Auburn state by-election was held on 9 November 1946 to elect the member for Auburn in the New South Wales Legislative Assembly, following the resignation of Jack Lang, who won the seat of Reid at the 1946 federal election. It was held on the same day as by-elections in Albury, Ashfield, and Corowa. Lang's son, Chris Lang, won the by-election with 52.32% of the vote.

zh.s: 新南威尔士州奥本选区于1946年11月9日举行州议员补选。此前，杰克·朗在1946年联邦选举中赢得里德选区议席后辞职。当天，奥尔伯里、阿什菲尔德和科罗瓦也举行了补选。杰克·朗的儿子克里斯·朗以52.32%的得票率赢得奥本选区补选。

en.s: The 1947 All-Ireland Senior Camogie Championship Final was the sixteenth All-Ireland Final and the deciding match of the 1947 All-Ireland Senior Camogie Championship, an inter-county camogie tournament for the top teams in Ireland. Antrim led by 2-2 to 2-0 at half-time and had a three-point lead in the last minute when Kathleen Cody sent in a shot at goal that would have equalised the game.

zh.t: 1947年全爱尔兰高级卡莫吉锦标赛决赛
zh.s: 1947年全爱尔兰高级卡莫吉锦标赛决赛是第16届全爱尔兰决赛，也是该届锦标赛的冠军争夺战。这项跨郡卡莫吉赛事由爱尔兰顶尖队伍参加。半场时安特里姆以2比2领先2比0；比赛最后一分钟时，安特里姆仍领先3分，凯瑟琳·科迪随后射门，原本有望扳平比分。

en.s: Operation Shmone (Hebrew: מִבְצָע שְׁמוֹנֶה, Mivtza Shmone, lit. Eight) was an Israeli military operation conducted against the Egyptian-held police fort of Iraq Suwaydan in the 1948 Arab–Israeli War. The battle was fought between the Israel Defense Forces and the Egyptian Army on November 9, 1948, and ended in an Israeli victory, following numerous previous Israeli attempts to capture the fort, two of them in Operation Yoav just weeks before. The Israeli 8th and Givati brigades attacked the fort in broad daylight following a heavy artillery barrage. After a hole was blown through the wall of the fort, the Egyptian forces surrendered.

zh.s: “什莫内”行动是1948年阿以战争期间，以色列对埃及控制的伊拉克苏韦丹警察要塞发动的一次军事行动。以色列国防军和埃及军队于1948年11月9日交战，最终以以军获胜告终。此前以军曾多次试图攻占该要塞，其中两次是在几周前的“约阿夫”行动中。当天，以色列第8旅和吉瓦提旅在猛烈炮击后于光天化日之下发起进攻，城堡墙上被炸开缺口后，埃军投降。

en.t: On November 9, 1949, employees of the China National Aviation Corporation (CNAC), under the Republic of China Ministry of Transportation and Communications, and the Central Air Transport (CAT) announced an uprising in British Hong Kong
en.s: The Two Airlines Incident (referred to in Taiwan as the "Two Airlines Defection" and in mainland China as the "Two Airlines Uprising") occurred during the late stage of the Chinese Civil War. On November 9, 1949, employees of the China National Aviation Corporation (CNAC), under the Republic of China Ministry of Transportation and Communications, and the Central Air Transport (CAT) announced an uprising in British Hong Kong.

zh.t: 中国航空公司与中央航空运输公司起义事件
zh.s: 中国航空公司（CNAC）是中华民国交通部下属企业。1949年11月9日，中国航空公司和中央航空运输公司的员工在英属香港宣布起义。这一事件发生在中国内战后期，在台湾称为“两航投共”，在中国大陆称为“两航起义”。

en.s: The 1952 Bulgarian Cup final was the 12th final of the Bulgarian Cup (in this period the tournament was named Cup of the Soviet Army), and was contested between Slavia Sofia and Spartak Sofia on 9 November 1952 at People's Army Stadium in Sofia. Slavia won the final 3–1.

zh.s: 1952年保加利亚杯决赛是第12届保加利亚杯决赛，当时该赛事称为苏军杯。索菲亚斯拉维亚队与索菲亚斯巴达克队于1952年11月9日在索菲亚人民军体育场交手，斯拉维亚队以3比1获胜。

en.s: The Kingdom of Cambodia, also known as the First Kingdom of Cambodia, and commonly referred to as the Sangkum period, refers to Norodom Sihanouk's first administration of Cambodia, lasting from the country's independence from France in 1953 to a military coup d'état in 1970. Sihanouk continues to be one of the most controversial figures in Southeast Asia's turbulent and often tragic postwar history.

zh.s: 柬埔寨王国也称第一柬埔寨王国，通常被称为“桑功时期”，指诺罗敦·西哈努克首次执政柬埔寨的时期，从1953年脱离法国独立持续至1970年军事政变。西哈努克至今仍是东南亚动荡且常伴悲剧的战后历史中最具争议的人物之一。

en.s: A coup d'état was attempted in Sudan in 1959, aimed at overthrowing Lieutenant General Ibrahim Abboud, but was thwarted. The military court sentenced officers involved, with some receiving the death penalty, marking Sudan's first post-independence execution.

zh.s: 1959年11月9日，苏丹发生针对易卜拉欣·阿布德中将的未遂政变。政变遭挫败后，军事法庭判处涉案军官，一些人被判死刑。这也导致苏丹独立后首次处决涉案军人。

en.s: The Berlin Crisis of 1961 (German: Berlin-Krise) was the last major European political and military incident of the Cold War concerning the status of the German capital city, Berlin, and of post–World War II Germany. The crisis culminated in the city's de facto partition by the East German erection of the Berlin Wall.

zh.s: 1961年柏林危机是冷战期间欧洲最后一次重大的政治和军事危机，争议焦点是德国首都柏林以及二战后德国的地位。危机最终以东德修建柏林墙、事实上将柏林分割告终。

en.s: The Tsurumi rail accident (鶴見事故 Tsurumi jiko, or "Tsurumi accident") occurred on November 9, 1963 between Tsurumi Station and Shin-Koyasu Station on the Tōkaidō Main Line in Yokohama, Japan, about 30 kilometres (20 mi) south of Tokyo, when two passenger trains collided with a derailed freight train, killing 162 people.

zh.s: 鹤见列车事故发生于1963年11月9日，地点在日本横滨的鹤见站与新子安站之间的东海道本线上，距东京以南约30公里。两列客车与一列脱轨货车相撞，造成162人死亡。

en.s: Presidential, legislative and local elections were held on November 9, 1965, in the Philippines. Incumbent President Diosdado Macapagal lost his opportunity to get a second full term as President of the Philippines to Senate President Ferdinand Marcos. His running mate, Senator Gerardo Roxas lost to former Vice President Fernando Lopez. Emmanuel Pelaez did not run for vice president. An unprecedented twelve candidates ran for president, however nine of those were nuisance candidates. This was the first election where all of the major presidential candidates were born after the Spanish colonization of the Philippines.

zh.s: 菲律宾于1965年11月9日举行总统、立法机关和地方选举。现任总统迪奥斯达多·马卡帕加尔未能连任，参议院议长费迪南德·马科斯当选总统。马卡帕加尔的竞选搭档、参议员赫拉尔多·罗哈斯也败给了前副总统费尔南多·洛佩斯。埃曼努埃尔·佩莱兹没有竞选副总统。共有12名候选人竞选总统，其中9人被认为是凑数候选人。这是菲律宾所有主要总统候选人都出生于西班牙殖民统治结束之后的首次选举。

en.s: A senatorial election was held on November 9, 1965 in the Philippines. The Nacionalista Party wrestled back control of the Senate; originally a Liberal, Senate President Ferdinand Marcos defected to the Nacionalistas, became their presidential candidate and won this year's election. The Nacionalistas also won 5 of the 8 seats contested in this year's Senate election to get the plurality (12) of the seats in the 24-member senate.

zh.s: 菲律宾于1965年11月9日举行参议员选举。国民党重新取得参议院控制权。原属自由党的参议院议长费迪南德·马科斯转投国民党，成为该党总统候选人，并在当年总统选举中胜出。国民党还赢得本次改选的8个席位中的5席，在24席的参议院中以12席成为席位最多的政党。

en.s: Presidential, legislative and local elections ere held on November 9, 1965, in the Philippines. Incumbent President Diosdado Macapagal lost his opportunity to get a second full term as President of the Philippines to Senate President Ferdinand Marcos. His running mate, Senator Gerardo Roxas lost to former Vice President Fernando Lopez. Emmanuel Pelaez did not run for vice president.

Despite Ferdinand Marcos of the opposition Nacionalista Party winning the presidential election, Liberal Party congressmen did not defect to the Nacionalista Party.

en.s: The 1966 Fianna Fáil leadership election in the Republic of Ireland began in October 1966 following the decision of Seán Lemass to resign as party leader and Taoiseach. Lemass had occupied both posts for over seven years and, while there was no pressure on him to resign, he felt that the time was right to hand over to a new generation. His successor was elected by the members of the Fianna Fáil parliamentary party on 9 November 1966. After one ballot the election was won by Jack Lynch.

en.s: Apollo 4 (November 9, 1967), also known as SA-501, was the uncrewed first test flight of the Saturn V launch vehicle, the rocket that eventually took astronauts to the Moon. The space vehicle was assembled in the Vehicle Assembly Building, and was the first to be launched from Kennedy Space Center (KSC) in Florida, ascending from Launch Complex 39, where facilities built especially for the Saturn V had been constructed.

zh.s: 阿波罗4号（也称SA-501）于1967年11月9日发射，是土星五号运载火箭的首次无人试飞。这种火箭后来将宇航员送上月球。飞行器在装配大楼组装，并首次从佛罗里达州肯尼迪航天中心39号发射台发射升空；该发射台设施是专为土星五号建造的。

en.s: Massachusetts v. Laird, 400 U.S. 886 (1970), was a case dealing with the conscription aspect of the Vietnam War that the Supreme Court declined to hear by a 6–3 vote. en.s: Presidential elections were held in Gabon on 9 November 1986. The country was a one-party state at the time, with the Gabonese Democratic Party as the sole legal party. en.s: The 1986 Montreal municipal election took place on November 9, 1986, to elect a mayor and city councillors in Montreal, Quebec, Canada. Elections also took place in suburban Montreal communities.

en.t: Jiang Zemin is named chair of the Communist Party's Central Military Commission
en.s: On November 9, 1989, the Chinese Communist Party's 13th Central Committee adopted a decision naming Jiang Zemin chair of the Party's Central Military Commission. The move followed its acceptance of Deng Xiaoping's request to leave that Party post. Jiang had already become the Party's general secretary in June. This November decision concerned the Party military commission, a separate office from the chairmanship of China's state Central Military Commission.
en.n: The November 9 decision appointed Jiang to the Party's Central Military Commission; his other leadership posts began on different dates.

zh.t: 江泽民出任中共中央军委主席
zh.s: 1989年11月9日，中共十三届五中全会决定接受邓小平辞去中共中央军委主席职务的请求，并决定由江泽民接任。江泽民此前已在同年6月出任中共中央总书记。这次任命涉及中共中央军委主席职务，与国家中央军委主席是两个不同的职位。

en.t: Stari Most, the "old bridge" in the Bosnian city of Mostar, built in 1566, collapses after several days of bombing by Croat forces during the Croat–Bosniak War
en.s: The Old Bridge (Serbo-Croatian: Stari most), also known as the Mostar Bridge, is a rebuilt 16th-century Ottoman bridge in the city of Mostar in Bosnia and Herzegovina. It crosses the river Neretva and connects the two parts of the city, which is named after the bridge keepers (mostari) who guarded the Old Bridge during the Ottoman era.

zh.t: 莫斯塔尔的“老桥”斯塔里莫斯特建于1566年，在克罗地亚—波斯尼亚战争期间遭克罗地亚军队连续数日轰炸后坍塌
zh.s: 老桥（塞尔维亚-克罗地亚语：Stari most），又称莫斯塔尔桥，是位于波黑莫斯塔尔市的一座重建后的16世纪奥斯曼桥梁。桥横跨内雷特瓦河，连接城市两岸。莫斯塔尔市名源自奥斯曼时期守护老桥的桥卫（mostari）。

en.s: Presidential elections were held in Sri Lanka on 9 November 1994. They were the third presidential elections held in the country's history. Prime Minister Chandrika Kumaratunga of the governing People's Alliance was elected in a landslide victory, receiving 62% of the vote and becoming the first female President of Sri Lanka. The election marked the end of 17 years of United National Party rule in Sri Lanka.

zh.s: 斯里兰卡于1994年11月9日举行总统选举，这是该国历史上的第三次总统选举。执政联盟人民阵线的总理钱德里卡·库马拉通加以62%的得票率大胜，当选总统，成为斯里兰卡首位女总统。这次选举结束了统一国民党在斯里兰卡长达17年的执政。

en.s: K-1 Grand Prix '97 Final was a kickboxing event promoted by the K-1 organization. It was the fifth K-1 World Grand Prix final involving eight of the world's best heavyweight fighters (+95 kg/209 lbs), with all bouts fought under K-1 Rules. The eight finalists had all qualified via elimination fights at the K-1 Grand Prix '97 1st Round. Also on the card was a four-man tournament for featherweight kickboxers (57 kg/126 lbs) based in Japan and a local 'Super Fight', with all bouts fought under K-1 Rules. In total there were fourteen fighters at the event, representing seven countries.

en.s: Survivor Series (1997) was the 11th annual Survivor Series pay-per-view professional wrestling event produced by the World Wrestling Federation. en.s: TAESA Flight 725 was a scheduled flight originating in Tijuana International Airport and ending at Mexico City International Airport with intermediate stopovers in Guadalajara and Uruapan, that crashed shortly after departure from the latter city's airport on November 9, 1999, killing all 18 passengers and crew on board. en.s: The 2005 Amman bombings were a series of coordinated bomb attacks on three hotel lobbies in Amman, Jordan, on 9 November 2005. The attacks killed 60 people and injured 115 others. The explosions at the Grand Hyatt Hotel, the Radisson SAS Hotel, and the Days Inn started at around 20:50 local time (18:50 UTC) at the Grand Hyatt. The three hotels are frequented by foreign diplomats. The bomb at the Radisson SAS exploded in the Philadelphia Ballroom, where a wedding hosting hundreds of guests was taking place. Al-Qaeda in Iraq immediately claimed the attack.

en.t: November 2024 Czech Pirate Party leadership election
en.s: The Czech Pirate Party held a leadership election on 9 November 2024. The previous party leadership, including Ivan Bartoš, resigned in September 2024, following poor results in the regional and senate elections.

zh.s: 捷克海盗党于2024年11月9日举行党魁选举。此前，伊万·巴尔托什等党领导人因地区选举和参议院选举表现不佳，于2024年9月辞职。

en.t: UFC Fight Night: Magny vs. Prates
en.s: UFC Fight Night: Magny vs. Prates (also known as UFC Fight Night 247, UFC Vegas 100, and UFC on ESPN+ 105) was a mixed martial arts event produced by the Ultimate Fighting Championship that took place on November 9, 2024, at the UFC Apex in Enterprise, Nevada, part of the Las Vegas Valley, United States.

zh.t: UFC格斗之夜：马格尼对阵普拉特斯
zh.s: UFC格斗之夜：马格尼对阵普拉特斯又称UFC格斗之夜247、UFC拉斯维加斯100和UFC ESPN+ 105，是终极格斗冠军赛举办的一场综合格斗赛事，于2024年11月9日在美国内华达州恩特普赖斯的UFC Apex举行，地点位于拉斯维加斯山谷。

en.s: Slaughterhouse (2024) was a professional wrestling event produced by Major League Wrestling (MLW). It was originally scheduled to take place on October 4, 2024, at The Coliseum in St. Petersburg, Florida. MLW canceled the event due to Hurricane Helene. The event's name was repurposed as a TV special that aired on beIN Sports and MLW's YouTube channel, with matches being taped at Lucha Apocalypto on November 9, 2024.

zh.t: 2024年《屠宰场》摔角节目比赛录制
zh.s: 2024年11月9日，美国职业摔角联盟MLW在《摔角末日》中录制了后来用于《屠宰场》电视特别节目的比赛。《屠宰场》原计划于10月4日在佛罗里达州圣彼得堡举行，但因飓风海伦取消；主办方随后沿用这一名称制作电视节目。
